added.title: aicodeking/dsh-superagent-gui
added.why_relevant: Local web GUI created in this window. An installed agent CLI works in a git worktree or a plain copy; the folder changes only on Merge or Apply. Keeps Trigger, Mandate, and default observe (inferred work becomes a suggestion). Leaves out Feishu, GitHub polling, and cordis packaging. DSH is spawned as dsh --profile headless and the README marks that live run unconfirmed. Node 22.12+, no runtime dependencies, version 0.1.0. macOS and Linux. Not a DeepSeek product. MIT, copyright retained for the DeepSeek Harness Team.
